comments.note: Pre-existing class naming inconsistency: `BreakTests.php` declares `final class HubL_BreakTests` (underscore prefix) while `ShowSnippetTests.php` declares `final class ShowSnippetTests` (no prefix). Both files share the same namespace `MailcodeTests\Translator\HubL`. The new constraints.md section correctly cites `ShowSnippetTests.php` as the canonical pattern, but does not explicitly warn against copying the `HubL_` prefix found in the older `BreakTests.php`. Recommend a future cleanup WP to either (a) rename `HubL_BreakTests` to `BreakTests`, or (b) add a brief note to the convention that the `HubL_` prefix is a legacy artefact to be avoided in new files.

The constraint text states separate `test_<variant>()` methods for stub commands, using `BreakTests.php` implicitly as an example and `ShowSnippetTests.php` as the reference. Since `BreakTests.php` currently has only one variant (`test_basic`), the motivation for 'separate methods' (granular failure localisation) is better illustrated by `ShowSnippetTests.php` — which the section already cites as the reference file. This choice is sound.
